sources.title: ControlNet - Learn AI
sources.snippet: ControlNet is a neural network architecture designed to add spatial conditioning controls to large, pretrained text-to-image diffusion models. Introduced in a February 2023 paper titled "Adding Conditional Control to Text-to-Image Diffusion Models" by Lvmin Zhang, Anyi Rao, and Maneesh Agrawala of Stanford University, ControlNet enables users to guide image generation through a variety of ...

sources.snippet: Searching for a ControlNet model can be time-consuming, given the variety of developers offering their versions. Each model has its unique features. I'll list all ControlNet models, versions and provide Hugging Face's download links for easy access to the desired ControlNet model. Edmond AI Art is a reader-supported publication.

sources.title: ControlNet Explained: Guided Image Generation | AI/TLDR
sources.snippet: ControlNet was an early, hugely influential answer to a general question — how do you steer a generative model with something other than text? That same impulse shows up across modern image tools: reference-based generation, structural adapters, and lighter-weight conditioning methods all chase the same goal.
